model_card.summary: Deep learning model for detecting pneumonia from chest X-rays. Assists radiologists by flagging suspicious regions and providing confidence scores.
model_card.intended_use_and_workflow: Radiologist decision support. Model highlights regions of interest; final diagnosis remains with the clinician.
model_card.how_to_use: Upload DICOM or JPEG chest X-ray. Model returns bounding boxes and confidence scores. Integrates with PACS via FHIR.
model_card.targeted_patient_population: Adults and pediatric patients presenting with respiratory symptoms
model_card.cautioned_out_of_scope_settings: Not for lateral or oblique views. Not validated for portable or bedside X-rays.
model_card.known_risks_and_limitations: Sensitivity lower on pediatric cases. Requires high-quality anterior-posterior or posterior-anterior views.
model_card.known_biases_or_ethical_considerations: Training data skewed toward certain demographics. Active bias audits in place.
model_card.outcomes_and_outputs: Bounding boxes, confidence scores, suggested differential diagnoses
model_card.output_and_input_data_types: Image input, structured JSON output with coordinates and scores
model_card.bias_mitigation_approaches: Stratified sampling, subgroup analysis, continuous monitoring
model_card.security: HIPAA compliant. Images processed in secure cloud.
model_card.transparency: Technical documentation and bias reports available.
model_card.stakeholders_consulted: Radiologists, FDA consultants, patient advisory board
model_card.patient_consent_or_disclosure: De-identified data; consent waived per IRB
model_card.bibliography: Okonkwo et al. (2026). Deep Learning for Pneumonia Detection. Radiology AI.

usefulness.interpretation: Meets clinical targets. mAP improved in v2.

safety.metric_goal: Zero critical failures in 10k-case safety study
